## PATCH `/api/2.29/password-policies`

**Tier:** T2 (T3 if it destroys, eradicates, disables or overwrites)  

Modifies one or more password policies. To enable a policy, set `enabled=true`. To disable a policy, set `enabled=false`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |

| `names` | query | array of string |  | Performs the operation on the unique names specified. Enter multiple names in comma-separated format. For example, `name01,name02`. If there is not at least one resource that matches each of the elements of `names`,… |

**Request body** (required): `PasswordPolicy`

| `name` | string | A user-specified name. The name must be locally unique and can be changed. |
